propositions: 27 verified codebase-health audit findings require remediation across code review provenance wiring, CI enforcement, documentation completeness, and library safety
Code-review request provenance (--ref/--source reaching CodeReviewRequest with source/verified_at_sha fields) must be wired consistently with sibling producers
Snapshot-entry contract, LLM-Review vote attachment, and exit-code documentation must be enforced by CI gates rather than asserted in ADRs
Deprecated config files and obsolete modules (bug_close_reason_ok, _attestation.py, validate --fix) must be removed and documentation corrected

Five serialized dependency chains constrain remediation sequencing: comment-triage must read final code after all point fixes; ADR renumbering must land last; review-plan and claim must run back-to-back to avoid attestation staleness
No library read path must call sys.exit; passed-but-unsigned retry logic must be available from one shared implementation accessible to both CLI and MCP
